name: Maranhão
summary: Nine horizontal stripes (four white, three red, two black) with a blue canton holding a white star.
origin: The poet Joaquim de Sousa Andrade created the flag after the proclamation of the Republic.

symbols.name: White star
symbols.description: A single star in the canton.
symbols.meaning: Beta Scorpii, the star that represents Maranhão on the national flag.

facts: The three stripe colours stand for the three groups that formed the population.
São Luís, the capital, was founded by the French in 1612.
clues: White, red and black stripes with a star in a blue canton.
Its stripe colours represent three peoples.
Its star is in the constellation Scorpius.
